# Test fixtures

- `plant.mp4`: a small, non-private H.264 clip for the upload API tests. It is the test media of Meta's
  [CameraAccess sample](https://github.com/facebook/meta-wearables-dat-ios/tree/main/samples/CameraAccess) (source
  archive SHA-256 `5973f2aa484831790fab40ceaace88286b0afaa6467620ca13a8a190fca494c1`), covered by the
  [Meta Wearables Developer Terms](https://wearables.developer.meta.com/terms). It is never team footage.
